title: Issue 78
description: x-defaultProperties (on the object) is a whitelist for which optional properties show by default. x-defaultProperty (on a property itself) overrides that whitelist either way - needed so a property reused via $ref can decide for itself, per consumer.

fax.title: Fax
fax.description: Not in x-defaultProperties, but its own x-defaultProperty:true still shows it by default.

website.title: Website
website.description: Listed in x-defaultProperties, but its own x-defaultProperty:false still hides it by default.
